name: pr_review_sweep
description: Review each new open PR head revision once.

repo.description: 'owner/name' GitHub repository slug to sweep for open PRs needing an initial review.

agent.description: Coding agent identifier passed through to each dispatched pr_review child workflow.

approvalJudgePromptTemplate.description: Inline prompt template for the approval judge, passed through to each dispatched child workflow.

approvalJudgePromptTemplateSource.description: Provenance label for the approval judge prompt template.

approvalMode.description: Approval mode passed through to each dispatched child workflow (e.g. human or auto).

judgeAgent.description: Coding agent identifier used for judge steps in each dispatched child workflow.

judgeMaxBudgetUsd.description: Maximum USD budget for judge steps in each dispatched child workflow.

judgeMaxTurns.description: Maximum turns allowed for judge steps in each dispatched child workflow.

judgeModel.description: Legacy single-model override for judge steps in each dispatched child workflow.

maxActive.description: Maximum concurrently-active review automation runs allowed before new candidates are capacity-blocked.

maxApprovalRevisions.description: Maximum number of approval revision rounds allowed in each dispatched child workflow.

maxNew.description: Maximum newly-eligible open PRs to dispatch for review this sweep.

model.description: Legacy generic model override applied to plan and code roles in each dispatched child workflow.

modelProfile.description: Named model-policy profile to select when resolving models for this sweep.

modelPolicy.description: Inline model policy document merged on top of the bundled and repository policies.

modelPolicySource.description: Label recorded for the inline modelPolicy's provenance.

modelPolicySha256.description: Expected canonical SHA-256 of the inline modelPolicy.

modelsConfig.description: Relative path (inside the worktree) to the repository model policy file.

modelOverrides.description: Per-role overrides merged on top of the selected profile's roles.

reviewPromptTemplate.description: Inline prompt template for the review step, passed through to each dispatched child workflow.

reviewPromptTemplateSource.description: Provenance label for the review prompt template.

verificationProfile.description: Named verification profile passed through to each dispatched child workflow.

blocked.description: Otherwise-eligible open PRs deferred purely due to capacity (reason: 'capacity').

childWorkflowId.description: Workflow instance id of the started pr_review child; empty string if the claim was lost.

claimed.description: True if this dispatch won the race to claim the revision and started the child workflow.

childWorkflowIds.description: Map of dynamic dispatch task reference name (one per eligible candidate this sweep) to that automation_dispatch sub-workflow's output.

claimed.description: Number of candidates selected for dispatch within capacity this sweep (same count as 'eligible', despite the name).

dispatched.description: Number of candidates selected for dispatch within capacity this sweep (same count as 'eligible').

eligible.description: Number of candidates selected for dispatch within capacity this sweep.

scanned.description: Number of open pull requests fetched from GitHub for this sweep.

skipped.description: Candidates excluded from dispatch, each annotated with a 'reason' (e.g. draft, retry_backoff, suppressed, exhausted).
